title: 来自明天的消息
logline: 深夜，一条来自自己号码的短信，让她发现明天的事故已经发生过。

scenes.title: 陌生的来信
scenes.narration: 晚上十一点，我收到一条短信。发件人，竟然是我自己。
scenes.visual: Medium close-up of the same adult woman sitting alone at a cafe table at night, looking down at a smartphone held below her face. Empty cafe, rainy window, warm tungsten lamp, dark blue exterior, cinematic thriller photography, no text.
scenes.motion: She notices a vibration from her phone, glances down slowly, then raises her eyes with a puzzled expression. A very slow camera push-in. Minimal natural movement.

scenes.title: 明天的时间
scenes.narration: 发送时间是明天凌晨。消息只有一句：不要坐上末班车。
scenes.visual: Close-up portrait of the same woman lit by a cool phone screen, holding her smartphone low in frame, eyebrows slightly raised, empty night cafe in soft background, cinematic suspense, no text.
scenes.motion: She reads something on her phone and freezes, her breathing becomes shallow. The camera remains nearly still, slowly moving closer to her worried eyes.

scenes.title: 照片里的我
scenes.narration: 紧接着，一张照片传来。空无一人的车站里，站着穿同一件衣服的我。
scenes.visual: Wide shot of the same woman in the same outfit standing alone under the shelter of an empty bus stop at night, rain on the pavement, distant street lamps, eerie blue and amber cinematic lighting, no text.
scenes.motion: She stands still at a deserted bus stop as rain falls beyond the shelter. The camera drifts slowly to the right, her hair moving very slightly in the wind.

scenes.title: 身后的脚步
scenes.narration: 我明明还没出门。可照片背后，为什么会有一个人的脚步声？
scenes.visual: Over-the-shoulder shot of the same woman inside a dark empty cafe, looking toward a glass entrance door, a faint blurry silhouette far outside the rainy glass, suspense film still, no text.
scenes.motion: The woman slowly turns her head toward the cafe entrance, pausing to listen. Camera held steady. Distant rain shimmers outside the door.

scenes.title: 第二条警告
scenes.narration: 第二条消息亮起：别回头。我刚才，就是在这里回头的。
scenes.visual: Tight close-up of the same woman's anxious face, face half lit by warm cafe lamp and half in shadow, her hand gripping a phone near her chest, suspense cinema, no text.
scenes.motion: She holds her breath, her eyes move slightly to the side, her fingers tighten gently around the phone. Slow restrained push-in, no sudden movement.

scenes.title: 空掉的街道
scenes.narration: 我冲出咖啡馆。街上没有车，也没有人。所有钟表，都停在十一点零三分。
scenes.visual: Full body shot of the same woman in the same outfit standing outside a closed cafe on an empty rain-soaked city street at night, mist, deep blue shadows, warm doorway, cinematic thriller, no text.
scenes.motion: She takes one small hesitant step forward and looks along the empty street. Camera gently pulls back, revealing the deserted pavement. Rain and a slight breeze.

scenes.title: 唯一的出口
scenes.narration: 手机第三次震动。这一次不是警告，而是一个请求：替我把消息，发回昨天。
scenes.visual: Medium portrait of the same woman standing by a rainy cafe window at night, holding a smartphone with both hands, expression changing from fear to determination, warm rim light, film still, no text.
scenes.motion: She looks down, slowly types a short message with her thumb, then looks up with resolve. Subtle handheld camera movement, her face remains consistent.

scenes.title: 循环开始
scenes.narration: 我按下发送。屏幕上的收件人，是昨天的我。远处，末班车的灯，终于亮了。
scenes.visual: Back three-quarter view of the same woman in the same outfit on an empty wet street at night, holding a phone, a distant pair of soft bus headlights glowing in fog, suspense ending, cinematic photography, no text.
scenes.motion: The woman remains still as a pair of distant headlights slowly brightens through the mist. Camera slowly pulls away, rain reflecting the lights, ending on a mysterious stillness.
